items.rationale: F-TB03 registers RB1 release evidence only and introduces no alternate production kernel.
No kernel I/O, parser, format, file-unit or path behavior is changed; testbank metadata remains external to the kernel.
Every adopted case keeps parameter, forcing, initial/committed state, solver, oracle and evidence authorities explicit and separate.
No persistent runtime state is added; the release bank stores evidence metadata rather than column state.
No worker/Newton/Jacobian/constitutive scratch ownership changes are made.
No production memory layout, pool, batch or object-per-column decision is changed.
The adopted restart/root/surface cases preserve existing transaction and rejected-trial authorities; F-TB03 changes no timestep implementation.
Committed-boundary restart evidence remains authoritative and solver/warm-start scratch is not promoted to persistent state.
Runtime cases state generic [t0,t1] time explicitly; the static architecture case marks time as not applicable and introduces no calendar assumption.
No coupling-window size or midnight/day restriction is introduced.
Coupling remains a core architecture concern; F-TB03 does not claim broader coupling release capability.
No H_SWAP/H_MF or q_SWAP/q_MF interface contract is changed or newly qualified.
Parallel restart and root cases retain hard mass gates; surface evaporation inherits its exact no-duplicate-booking authority; no mass gate is relaxed.
No groundwater-interface sensitivity or response-tangent contract is changed.
No predictor/corrector execution-cost path or coupling-run-count policy is changed.
Restricted MultiSWAP restart/root evidence is permanently indexed without changing worker execution, scheduling or solver-instance ownership.
No one-to-one MODFLOW-cell mapping or surface-tile composition assumption is introduced.
Deep-vadose remains an optional external component and is untouched.
No transition between direct coupling and deep-vadose storage is implemented or reinterpreted.
RB1 Full Richards REFERENCE authority is preserved without hard-coding away the common soil-water seam; RossFast remains a nonclaim.
No production physics is copied or reimplemented; F-TB03 indexes immutable existing scientific evidence.
No module gains a dependency on HeadCalc internals.
Physical capability, solver policy and performance evidence remain distinct; no performance evidence is used to broaden physics.
No bounded-cost/fallback policy is introduced; surface-evaporation throughput/scaling remains explicitly outside the adopted scientific claim.
Full-accuracy REFERENCE authority remains pinned as the RB1 soil-water reference mode.
Release evidence, diagnostics and workflow records are observable metadata and do not become a second runtime-state authority.
No optional physics module, persistent column state or runtime cost is activated by testbank registration.
Tile fractions, MODFLOW mapping and system composition remain runtime/coupler responsibilities outside the kernel.
Cases pin exact authorities and explicit time semantics; no implicit .swp, midnight, one-day or direct-MODFLOW dependency is introduced.
F-TB03 explicitly audits the RB1 release-bank adoption against all 30 SWAP architecture invariants.
